name: Clinify SaaS Dashboard
style: .clinify-saas-dashboard{background:#fff;padding:8px 4px 28px;font-family:inherit;color:#1f2937}.clinify-saas-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 0 18px}.clinify-saas-header h2{margin:0;font-size:24px;font-weight:600}.clinify-saas-header p{margin:5px 0 0;color:#6b7280;font-size:13px}.clinify-saas-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}.clinify-saas-metric{border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;padding:16px 18px;min-height:86px}.clinify-saas-metric-label{font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:8px}.clinify-saas-metric-value{font-size:25px;font-weight:600;color:#111827}.clinify-saas-section{border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;padding:18px;margin-bottom:18px}.clinify-saas-section-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:13px}.clinify-saas-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.clinify-saas-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}.clinify-saas-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}.clinify-saas-table th{background:#f8fafc;color:#6b7280;font-weight:600;text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb;white-space:nowrap}.clinify-saas-table td{padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f1f3;white-space:nowrap}.clinify-saas-table tbody tr[data-tenant]{cursor:pointer}.clinify-saas-table tbody tr[data-tenant]:hover{background:#f8fafc}.clinify-saas-empty{text-align:center;color:#6b7280;padding:24px!important}.clinify-saas-loading{padding:30px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280}@media(max-width:1100px){.clinify-saas-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:650px){.clinify-saas-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr}.clinify-saas-section{padding:14px}.clinify-saas-header h2{font-size:21px}}
